@note: Chip design add-on, source and netlist panels (0.9 HD.1/HD.2, lib/chip/hdl). {var} placeholders are filled in by the add-on. chip.src.e.* are the Problems texts.
chip.src.title: Source
chip.src.hier.title: Hierarchy
chip.src.newName: Name of the new file (.v, .sv or .vhd)
chip.src.badName: The name must end in .v, .sv, .vh, .vhd or .vhdl
chip.src.nofiles: No Verilog or VHDL files in the project yet. Use New file, or add .v, .sv or .vhd files to the project.
chip.net.title: Netlist
chip.net.none: Pick a Verilog module to draw its netlist.
chip.net.vhdlNote: VHDL entities show in the hierarchy; the netlist drawing reads Verilog only.
chip.net.loops: {n} connections from a box back to itself are not drawn.
chip.net.tooBig: Too many cells to draw here. The netlist can still be saved as JSON.
chip.src.e.lex.string: A string is not closed before the end of the line
chip.src.e.lex.comment: A block comment is not closed
chip.src.e.syn.endname: The end name {got} does not match {want}
chip.src.e.syn.toomany: More than {n} errors in this file; the rest are not shown
chip.src.e.pp.include: `include "{name}" is not one of the project files
chip.src.e.sem.implicit: {name} is not declared; it becomes a one-bit wire
chip.src.e.sem.portdir: Port {name} of {scope} has no direction (input, output or inout)
chip.src.e.sem.portnotlisted: {name} is declared as a port but is not in the port list of {scope}
chip.src.e.sem.archnoentity: Architecture {arch} is of {name}, which is not an entity in the project
chip.src.e.hier.missing: {type} is used by {parent} (instance {inst}) but is not defined in the project
chip.src.e.hier.unused: {name} is never used and is not the top
chip.src.e.hier.notop: No top module or entity was found
chip.src.e.hier.manytops: More than one possible top: {names}; {top} is used
chip.src.e.hier.portcount: Instance {inst} of {type} connects {got} ports by position; {type} has {want}
chip.src.e.net.width: Pin {pin} of {inst} is {want} bits wide but is connected to {got} bits
chip.src.e.net.behavioural: {n} behavioural block(s) in {name} are shown as boxes, not gates
chip.src.e.net.generate: Generate blocks in {name} are not unrolled; {n} instance(s) inside them are not shown
chip.src.e.net.positional: Instance {inst} of {type} connects by position and {type} is not in the project; pins are numbered
chip.src.e.net.unknown: {name} is not a net or port of {scope}
chip.src.e.net.nomodule: Module {name} is not in the project
chip.src.e.net.dir: The direction of pin {pin} of {type} is guessed ({dir}); add a cell library for exact directions
chip.src.e.net.undriven: Net {net} feeds {inst} pin {pin} but nothing drives it
